messages.body_plain:
Hi,

Is it possible to use the summary statistics for different cohort together (may or may not have the sample overlap), ie half of the phenotypes form UKBB and few of the phenotypes from the in-house summary statistics?

Thanks,
Shams

messages.subject: Common factor GWAS
messages.body_plain:
Hi Michel,

I am just going through the GenomicSEM tutorial for the common factor GWAS, but I keep getting stuck when trying to align the summary statistics. Here is the error message:

traits <- c("scz.sumstats.gz","bip.sumstats.gz", "mdd.sumstats.gz", "ptsd.sumstats.gz", "anx.sumstats.gz")
sample.prev <- c(.39,.45,.35,.25,.32)
population.prev <- c(.01,.01,.16,.08,.29)
ld <- "eur_w_ld_chr/"
wld <- "eur_w_ld_chr/"
trait.names<-c("SCZ","BIP","MDD","PTSD","ANX")
LDSCoutput <- ldsc(traits, sample.prev, population.prev, ld, wld, trait.names)

> str(LDSCoutput)
List of 5
 $ V: num [1:15, 1:15] 7.49e-05 4.17e-05 1.56e-05 2.91e-05 1.77e-05 ...
 $ S: num [1:5, 1:5] 0.2445 0.1994 0.0619 0.0251 0.0651 ...
 $ I: num [1:5, 1:5] 1.05344 0.08895 0.04845 0.01369 0.00901 ...
 $ N: num [1, 1:15] 105318 41977 134983 31693 42697 ...
 $ m: int 1173569

p_sumstats <-sumstats(files,ref,trait.names,se.logit,info.filter=0.6, maf.filter=0.01,OLS=NULL,linprob=FALSE,prop=FALSE)
|--------------------------------------------------|
|==================================================|
Error in if (OLS[i] == T) { : argument is of length zero

Just wondering whether there is anything you can spot that is erroneous?

Thanks!
Tabea
